title: Build a basic report, apply filters, and execute
description: Verifies that a user can select an entity (items), choose fields (including dynamic ones), apply AND/OR filters, and run the report with pagination and sorting.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports (گزارش‌ساز)
Select the 'items' entity from the entity picker and select a warehouse
Verify that dynamic fields (dyn__*) are available in the field picker
Select basic and dynamic fields to include in the report
Create a nested AND/OR filter condition in the filter panel
Click the run/execute report button
Verify the report preview table displays the correct columns and applies pagination
Click on a column header to sort the data
Verify the table reloads and data is sorted accordingly

title: Apply grouping and aggregations
description: Verifies that a user can group the data by specific fields and apply aggregation functions like SUM, and the results are calculated correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select the 'items' entity and a warehouse
Open the grouping panel and select a field to group by (e.g., warehouse__name)
Add an aggregation function (SUM) on a numeric field (e.g., balance) with an alias
Click the run/execute report button
Verify the preview table displays grouped rows and the aggregated total is correctly calculated

title: Save, publish, and view a public report template
description: Verifies that a user can save a report as a template, make it public, and a second user can view it but not delete it.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Create a simple report with some fields selected
Save the current report configuration as a new template
Toggle the template visibility to 'Public' (عمومی)
Log out of the current user account
Log in with a second user account that has view_sys_reports permission
Navigate to /reports
Verify the public template created by the first user is visible in the saved reports sidebar
Verify the second user does not have a delete button for the public template

title: Export report to Excel (Immediate and Background)
description: Verifies that exporting a small report triggers an immediate download with RTL formatting, and exporting a large report shows a progress bar and a download button later.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Load a template that results in a small dataset (less than 10,000 rows)
Click the Export to Excel button
Verify the file downloads immediately and (if possible to inspect) the sheet view is right-to-left
Modify the filters to match a very large dataset (over 10,000 rows)
Click the Export to Excel button
Verify a background job is created, a progress bar appears, and eventually a download button is presented

title: Offline guard disables report builder
description: Verifies that when the application goes offline, the report builder UI displays a warning banner and disables interactive elements, and no requests enter the offline sync queue.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Simulate offline mode (e.g., via DevTools Network tab)
Verify a yellow offline warning banner is displayed on the page
Verify that run and export buttons are disabled
Attempt to trigger any report action if possible
Verify that the IndexedDB offline sync queue remains empty (proving SKIP_OFFLINE works)

title: Apply NOT filter on leaves and groups
description: Verifies that the NOT (!) button works for individual conditions (leaves) and group headers, reversing the result set appropriately.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select the 'items' entity and a warehouse
Add a simple condition, e.g., name contains 'laptop'
Click the NOT (!) toggle button on the condition row so its color changes to rose
Click run/execute
Verify the results exclude items with 'laptop'
Create a filter group with OR
Toggle the NOT button on the group header
Click run/execute
Verify the results return the complement of the OR group

title: Apply HAVING condition to aggregated results
description: Verifies that filtering grouped data (HAVING) works for basic operators and the 'between' operator.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select 'items' and a warehouse
Group by warehouse name and add a SUM aggregation for balance
In the 'HAVING' section, select the SUM alias, choose 'GreaterThanOrEqual' (>=), and enter 100
Click run/execute
Verify only groups with sum_balance >= 100 are shown
Change the HAVING operator to 'Between' and enter 10 and 50
Click run/execute
Verify only groups with sum_balance between 10 and 50 are shown

title: Chart visualization and limitations
description: Verifies that chart renders for grouped results, supports changing types, and shows warning for large sets.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports
Select 'items', group by category, and add a SUM aggregation
Click run/execute
Verify the Chart section (Section 6) appears
Select Chart Type 'Bar', X-axis as category, and Y-axis as the SUM aggregation
Verify the chart canvas renders the data
Switch chart type to 'Pie' and then to 'Line'
Verify the chart updates accordingly
Select a grouping that yields more than 50 rows (e.g. group by item ID)
Click run/execute
Verify a warning message appears stating that only the first 50 groups are charted
